text: Seismic design shall be per TBDY 2018 for the design earthquake DD-2 (475-year), site peak ground acceleration 0.45 g and site class ZD (Vs30 = 240 m/s). The site-specific hazard study CV-STU-0001 shall define the design spectrum; if the site-specific spectrum is lower than the code spectrum for the ZD class, the code spectrum shall not be reduced by more than the limit TBDY 2018 permits (80 % of the code value at any period).
